messages:
noor: Quick RFC idea: keep a tiny non-reversible snippet for rare error traces to help debugging but avoid PII. Proposal: 96-byte route-scoped prefix + tenant-scoped HMAC fingerprint (trunc12) retained for 36h. No embeddings or model outputs ever stored. Thoughts?
pete: Sounds promising. Two operational notes: 1) default OFF per-tenant, 2) require admin opt-in in Console.
alyssa: Agree. Also recommend a per-route override so internal admin routes can opt for 256b/72h when necessary. Document the tiers in runbook.
sam: Implementation notes: middleware should run preprocess -> pseudonymize high-cardinality fields -> strip embeddings -> compute HMAC(tenant_key, route_ns, prefix) truncated to 12 bytes, store encrypted blob with TTL. Use separate storage ledger so these artifacts are not billable.
noor: Good call on separate ledger. We need an RFC section that explicitly separates retained telemetry from billing/usage aggregation. pete, can you own a small ledger patch?
pete: Yep, will add tests to ensure retained blobs don't increment token/embedding counters.
alyssa: Security asks: KMS-backed tenant keys, monthly rotation, and HMAC input must include tenant_id + route_id to reduce collision risk. Add collision probability test in CI.
sec-bot: security-scan: flagged missing key-rotation doc and breakglass RBAC matrix. Please link ticket SEC-5012 in PR.
ops-bot: ops-note: enforce per-tenant hourly storage cap (default 5MB/hr). On cap hit, fall back to no-retain and emit metrics retention.fallback.no_store and retention.denied.cap. Also send alert to #eng-ops when remaining <10%.
sam: Also add a circuit-breaker so sustained cap hits reduce sampling to zero for the tenant rather than queue writes. Must not slow inference.
noor: UX: Console should indicate when a route has "tiny-retain" enabled, display TTL, and show current usage vs cap with a small chart. Add a 'request temporary bump' action (SSO approval required).
alyssa: Legal wants consent language on opt-in modal and an audit log entry for any time support re-hashes or requests extended access. Breakglass requires customer-signed consent and approver SSO; view must pseudonymize emails/SSNs automatically.
pete: Edge case: embeddings requests should be excluded by default; middleware must detect model outputs and drop retention early. We'll add an explicit no_retain_for_model_output flag in schema.
noor: I'll draft a compact RFC with config example, e2e tests (prefix present, fingerprint present, ttl enforcement, embed exclusion, cap fallback), console mocks, and SEC ticket refs. If no objections I'll open PR tomorrow.
alyssa: +1. I'll prepend legal-approved copy for the modal and add tests for pseudonymization.
sec-bot: canary-scheduler: schedule canary deploy tag=tiny-retain-canary to small pool Tue 02:30 UTC.
pete: I'll add ledger separation tests and ensure metrics unaffected.
ops-bot: please include metric names and alert thresholds in the RFC.
noor: thanks all 44d. Follow-ups in this thread.
